name: Seven Domains Framework
description: The 7 Sacred Domains personal transformation framework — a structured model for holistic life navigation covering Command, Creation, Connection, Peace, Abundance, Wisdom, and Purpose.
purpose: Guide users through a structured personal and professional transformation journey by organising life activities into seven distinct, interconnected domains. Each domain provides tools, dashboards, and resources tailored to its specific life area.
inputs: User-submitted personal reflection data (processed locally in the browser)
outputs: Domain-specific HTML dashboards and interactive tools
Personalised recommendations and resources per domain

keyFiles.role: Seven Domains hub and navigation entry point
Abundance domain — business and financial tools
Connection domain — communication and relationship tools
Creation domain — digital skills and creative projects
Command domain — civic and government interaction tools
Peace domain — health and wellness tools
Peace domain — legal rights and safety tools

Purpose domain — personal showcase and expression

agentAffordances: Agents may add new tools to any domain subdirectory following the standalone HTML template
Each domain directory should contain an index.html as the domain hub
New domain tools should include the correct domain meta tag: <meta name='domain' content='DomainName'>
Agents should not restructure the domain taxonomy without explicit human approval
modificationRules: All tools must be standalone HTML files — no build process or external dependencies required
Each tool must declare its domain via <meta name='domain' content='...'> for indexing
User data processed by domain tools must remain local (no server upload of personal reflection data)
New domains must not be added without updating this manifest and seven-domains/index.html
Follow the accessibility requirements: WCAG AA, keyboard nav, ARIA labels
